content.user_title: Manage HR Policies and Employee Workflows
content.value_statement: HR teams need consistent, compliant templates for hiring, onboarding, leave, performance, and employee relations. This skill produces structured HR drafts, checklists, rubrics, and escalation notes.
actual_capabilities: Drafts job descriptions, structured interview kits, rubrics, scorecards, and debrief guides.
Creates onboarding and offboarding checklists with 30/60/90 plans.
Produces PTO and leave policy drafts with placeholders and legal notes.
Builds performance review packets, competency matrices, and PIP templates.
Prepares employee relations intake forms, investigation plans, and documentation standards.
Adds legal and privacy caveats when jurisdiction or sensitive data issues matter.
limitations: Does not provide legal advice or replace qualified local counsel.
Needs jurisdiction, company size, employment type, and policy constraints for specific guidance.
Cannot verify live legal changes unless users provide current sources.
Should not process unnecessary sensitive personal data.

use_cases.title: Create Hiring Kits
use_cases.description: Build structured interview questions, scorecards, rubrics, and debrief steps for a specific role.

use_cases.title: Standardize Employee Lifecycle Tasks
use_cases.description: Prepare onboarding plans, offboarding checklists, and communication drafts for repeatable HR workflows.

use_cases.title: Draft Foundational HR Policies
use_cases.description: Create baseline PTO, performance, and employee relations templates with counsel escalation notes.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a PTO Policy
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple HR policy draft.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a jurisdiction-neutral PTO policy for {{CompanyName}}. Ask up to three questions if needed. Include assumptions, policy text, rollout checklist, and employee announcement.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Interview Kit
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for structured hiring materials.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a structured interview kit for {{RoleTitle}} in {{Jurisdiction}}. Include competencies, eight job-related questions, 1-5 rubric anchors, scorecard fields, and debrief guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Onboarding Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a new-hire lifecycle plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 30/60/90 onboarding plan for a remote {{RoleTitle}} on {{TeamName}}. Include goals, stakeholders, training tasks, manager check-ins, and feedback milestones.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Employee Relations Package
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for sensitive workplace issue handling.
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare an employee relations investigation package for {{IssueType}} in {{Jurisdiction}}. Include intake questions, evidence standards, interview plan, findings memo outline, privacy cautions, and counsel escalation points.

output_examples.input: Create a structured interview kit for a customer success manager.
output_examples.output: A hiring package with role outcomes, competency rubric, interview questions, panel assignments, scorecard guidance, and a debrief checklist.

output_examples.input: Draft an accrual-based PTO policy for a 50-person company.
output_examples.output: A policy draft with eligibility rules, accrual method, carryover placeholders, request workflow, rollout checklist, and employee announcement text.

output_examples.input: Prepare a PIP template for a sales representative.
output_examples.output: A coaching-focused plan with objective performance gaps, measurable goals, support actions, check-in cadence, documentation standards, and escalation notes.

best_practices: Provide jurisdiction, company size, employment types, and internal policy constraints before asking for final language.
Use structured criteria and objective evidence for hiring, performance, and employee relations work.
Review high-risk actions with qualified counsel before implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for discriminatory hiring criteria or illegal interview questions.
Do not use generated policy text as final legal advice.
Do not include unnecessary medical, protected-class, or sensitive personal details.

faq.question: Can this skill write final legal policies?
faq.answer: It can draft HR policy templates, but qualified local counsel should review policies before implementation.

faq.question: What inputs improve the output?
faq.answer: Provide jurisdiction, company size, role details, employment type, union status, and existing policy constraints.

faq.question: Can it help with hiring interviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create job-related interview questions, scorecards, rubric anchors, and panel plans.

faq.question: Does it handle sensitive employee data?
faq.answer: It encourages data minimization and should only use sensitive data when strictly necessary.

faq.question: Can it support performance management?
faq.answer: Yes. It can draft competency matrices, review packets, goal templates, and PIP structures.

faq.question: Is it suitable for international HR work?
faq.answer: It can provide neutral drafts and jurisdiction prompts, but local counsel should confirm country-specific requirements.
